material_class.structural_family: undecanuclear Mn5Ln6 mixed-valence 3d–4f cluster with corner-shared oxo-bridged M4 cubes

synthesis.procedure: 2,6-Diformyl-4-methylphenol (657 mg, 4.0 mmol) and 2-aminoethanol (489 mg, 8.0 mmol) in methanol (20 ml) were added to manganese(II) acetate tetrahydrate (980 mg, 4.0 mmol) in methanol (50 ml), and triethylamine (607 mg, 6.0 mmol) was added. The solution was allowed to stand overnight, then gadolinium(III) nitrate hexahydrate (903 mg, 2.0 mmol) was added. After stirring for several minutes, the solution was filtered and layered with diethyl ether to give dark brown columnar crystals of 1.
synthesis.time: allowed to stand for one night, then stirred for several minutes after Ln addition
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reaction followed by filtration and diethyl ether layering
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered and layered with diethyl ether to give dark brown columnar crystals

properties.summary: dc susceptibility (1.8–300 K, 500 Oe) shows χmT = 55.727 emu mol−1 K at 300 K (below the 61.125 emu mol−1 K uncorrelated-spin value), a minimum of 49.918 emu mol−1 K at 42 K, and a rise to 71.169 emu mol−1 K at 1.8 K, indicating antiferromagnetic coupling among metal ions and a relatively large spin ground state. Magnetization saturates at 43.9 Nβ above 5.0 T at 1.8 K, consistent with six uncorrelated Gd3+ (S = 7/2) plus an antiferromagnetically coupled [MnIII4MnIV] core (S = 3/2) and negligible magnetic anisotropy. No frequency-dependent ac signals; 1 is not an SMM.

properties.summary: χmT decreases from 78.621 emu mol−1 K at 300 K (below the 84.753 emu mol−1 K uncorrelated-spin value) to 67.096 emu mol−1 K at 30 K, then rises to 96.823 emu mol−1 K at 2.2 K, indicating antiferromagnetic interactions and a large spin ground state. Frequency-dependent ac χm′ and χm″ signals confirm SMM behaviour; Arrhenius analysis of χm″ peak temperatures gives ΔE = 17.76 K and τ0 = 4.76 × 10−8 s. Magnetization saturates at 31.1 Nβ above 5.0 T at 1.8 K and indicates magnetic anisotropy originating mainly from the Tb ions.
